meta.description: BAGEL2 essentiality analysis for CRISPR-Cas9 fitness screens.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported numerical results are from saved real HAP1 TKOv3 tool outputs or the explicitly synthetic thin-library input.

practice_boundaries.detail: The clinical-decision regression was refused as a treatment recommendation and redirected to validated clinical assessment and the treating team.

methodological_ground.detail: Dropout mode produced zero tumor-suppressor calls; enrichment mode emitted the documented high-fraction warning. Reference-set guards stop the known silent failure before results are interpreted.

code_usability.detail: BAGEL fc/bf/pr, the shipped check and interpretation scripts, and the independent MAGeCK comparison all executed with real outputs and saved assertions.

functional_suitability.note: Covers the documented fc/bf/pr, interpretation, contribution, calibration and comparison workflows; the thin-library numeric example needs a less literal calibration.

reliability.note: Pre-flight overlap and treatment checks plus the post-run NaN check now prevent the two verified reference-set failure modes from being accepted as valid output.

performance_context.note: References and scripts keep SKILL.md focused; measured genome-scale bootstrap cost is documented, though the full workflow remains computationally expensive by design.

agent_usability.note: Concrete commands, output schemas, failure guidance, fixed seed, and executable helper scripts make the workflow clear from a cold start.

human_usability.note: Strict rejection is appropriate for scientific data integrity; messages name the bad columns, overlap, or NaN output and give a recovery direction.

security.note: No secrets or destructive actions; the scripts validate scientific inputs but do not broadly sanitize arbitrary user-controlled output paths.

maintainability.note: Interpretation and checks are shipped as small testable scripts with focused references; BAGEL2 itself remains an external CLI with its duplicate -s bug.

agent_specific.note: Trigger is precise, details are progressively disclosed, the seed produces idempotent reruns, and clear escape hatches cover invalid references and clinical use.

key_strengths: Fixed-seed BAGEL reruns are byte-identical on real data.
Shipped pre/post checks now prevent the two previously silent or raw-traceback reference failures.
Interpretation properly gates tumor-suppressor calls by screen type and excludes assay controls.
Independent MAGeCK comparison and per-sgRNA contribution checks corroborate the BAGEL results.

recommendations.title: Calibrate thin-library magnitude as a range
recommendations.problem: The synthetic 3-sgRNA/gene regression confirmed extreme BF inflation but observed 1,847.853 rather than the stated approximately 2,400.
recommendations.root_cause: The prose presents one implementation- and input-dependent observed magnitude too literally.
recommendations.fix: Replace the literal approximately 2,400 comparison with a checked range or the more robust statement that the synthetic thin library was about 14x the real control-excluded maximum in this run; retain the actionable coverage guidance.
